name: Inquiry
例文: I am writing to make an inquiry regarding the BCI lab requirements.
例文翻译: 我写信是想咨询关于脑机接口实验室的要求。

name: Attachment
例文: Please find the revised research proposal in the attachment.
例文翻译: 请在附件中查收修改后的研究计划书。

name: Clarify
例文: Could you please clarify the deadline for the preliminary report?
例文翻译: 您能澄清一下初报的截止日期吗？

name: Extension
例文: I would like to request a two-day extension for my programming project.
例文翻译: 我想申请将我的编程项目延期两天。

name: Absence
例文: Please accept my apologies for my absence from yesterday's seminar.
例文翻译: 请接受我对昨天缺席研讨会的道歉。

name: Recommendation
例文: I am writing to ask if you could provide a letter of recommendation for me.
例文翻译: 我写信是想问您是否可以为我提供一封推荐信。

name: Requirement
例文: What are the specific requirements for the part-time position?
例文翻译: 这个兼职职位的具体要求是什么？

name: Acknowledge
例文: Please acknowledge receipt of this email at your earliest convenience.
例文翻译: 请在方便时尽快确认收到此邮件。

name: Assistance
例文: I would greatly appreciate your assistance with this technical issue.
例文翻译: 如果您能协助我处理这个技术问题，我将不胜感激。

name: Feedback
例文: I am looking forward to receiving your feedback on my initial draft.
例文翻译: 我期待收到您对我初稿的反馈。

name: Procedure
例文: Could you explain the procedure for applying for the scholarship?
例文翻译: 您能解释一下申请奖学金的程序吗？

name: Registration
例文: The deadline for course registration is approaching quickly.
例文翻译: 课程注册的截止日期快到了。

name: Availability
例文: Please let me know your availability for a brief meeting next week.
例文翻译: 请告诉我您下周是否有空进行简短面谈。

name: Candidate
例文: I believe my background makes me a suitable candidate for the lab.
例文翻译: 我相信我的背景使我成为实验室的合适人选。

name: Enrollment
例文: The university has seen a substantial increase in international enrollment.
例文翻译: 该校的国际生入学人数大幅增加。

name: Syllabus
例文: The grading policy is clearly outlined in the course syllabus.
例文翻译: 评分政策在课程大纲中有明确列出。

name: Prerequisite
例文: Advanced calculus is a prerequisite for this neural engineering course.
例文翻译: 高等微积分是这门神经工程课程的先修课。

name: Evaluation
例文: The final evaluation will be based on both exams and participation.
例文翻译: 最终评估将基于考试和参与度。

name: Transcript
例文: You need to submit your official transcript to the admissions office.
例文翻译: 你需要向招生办提交你的官方成绩单。

name: Internship
例文: I am interested in applying for the summer internship at Matsuya.
例文翻译: 我有兴趣申请松屋的夏季实习。

name: Citing
例文: Please ensure you are correctly citing all your sources in the paper.
例文翻译: 请确保你在论文中正确引用了所有来源。

name: Collaborate
例文: I am eager to collaborate with other researchers in the BCI field.
例文翻译: 我非常渴望与脑机接口领域的其他研究人员合作。

name: Confirmation
例文: I am writing to seek confirmation of my interview time.
例文翻译: 我写信是为了确认我的面试时间。

name: Postpone
例文: The lecture has been postponed until further notice.
例文翻译: 讲座已推迟，另行通知。

name: Reschedule
例文: Would it be possible to reschedule our appointment to Friday?
例文翻译: 是否可以将我们的约会改到周五？

name: Supervise
例文: Professor Smith will supervise my research on signal processing.
例文翻译: 史密斯教授将指导我关于信号处理的研究。

name: Withdraw
例文: He decided to withdraw from the competition due to personal reasons.
例文翻译: 由于个人原因，他决定退出比赛。

name: Criteria
例文: What are the main criteria used for evaluating the research proposal?
例文翻译: 评估研究计划书的主要标准是什么？

name: Demonstrate
例文: The applicant must demonstrate proficiency in both English and Japanese.
例文翻译: 申请人必须证明其精通英语和日语。

name: Eligible
例文: Only full-time students are eligible to apply for the grant.
例文翻译: 只有全日制学生有资格申请这笔拨款。

name: Grant
例文: The lab received a significant grant to study neural plasticity.
例文翻译: 实验室获得了一笔可观的拨款用于研究神经可塑性。

name: Mandatory
例文: Attendance at the safety orientation is mandatory for all new students.
例文翻译: 所有新生必须参加安全培训。

name: Orientation
例文: The international student orientation will be held in the main hall.
例文翻译: 国际生迎新会将在大礼堂举行。

name: Notify
例文: Please notify the office if there is any change in your address.
例文翻译: 如果地址有变动，请通知办公室。

name: Permission
例文: You must obtain written permission before using the lab equipment.
例文翻译: 在使用实验室设备前，你必须获得书面许可。

name: Reference
例文: I have listed three professional references at the end of my resume.
例文翻译: 我在简历末尾列出了三个职业证明人。

name: Relevant
例文: Please attach any relevant documents to your application.
例文翻译: 请在申请中附上任何相关的文档。

name: Submission
例文: The deadline for the online submission is midnight tonight.
例文翻译: 网上提交的截止日期是今晚午夜。

name: Supervision
例文: The students worked under the close supervision of their professors.
例文翻译: 学生们在教授的密切指导下工作。

name: Tuition
例文: The university offers several options for paying tuition fees.
例文翻译: 大学提供几种支付学费的选择。

name: Urgent
例文: This is an urgent matter that requires your immediate attention.
例文翻译: 这是一个紧急事项，需要您立即关注。

name: Verification
例文: The bank requires verification of your current student status.
例文翻译: 银行需要验证你目前的学生身份。

name: Account
例文: Please ensure that your student account is active and up to date.
例文翻译: 请确保你的学生账户是激活的且信息是最新的。

name: Appreciation
例文: I would like to express my sincere appreciation for your help.
例文翻译: 我想对您的帮助表示由衷的感谢。

name: Authorization
例文: Access to the server requires special authorization from the IT department.
例文翻译: 访问服务器需要IT部门的特殊授权。

name: Benefit
例文: What are the main benefits of joining the student association?
例文翻译: 加入学生协会的主要好处是什么？

name: Catalog
例文: You can find the list of required books in the online catalog.
例文翻译: 你可以在网上目录中找到所需书籍的列表。

name: Circumstance
例文: Under certain circumstances the late fee may be waived.
例文翻译: 在某些情况下，滞纳金可以被豁免。

name: Complaint
例文: The dormitory manager addressed the student's complaint about the heating.
例文翻译: 宿舍管理员处理了学生关于暖气的投诉。

name: Consultation
例文: I would like to book a consultation with the career advisor.
例文翻译: 我想预约一次与职业顾问的咨询。

name: Convenience
例文: Please reply at your earliest convenience.
例文翻译: 请在方便时尽快回复。

name: Deadline
例文: Missing the deadline will result in a lower grade.
例文翻译: 错过截止日期会导致成绩降低。

name: Detailed
例文: The professor provided detailed instructions for the final exam.
例文翻译: 教授为期末考试提供了详细的说明。

name: Discrepancy
例文: There appears to be a discrepancy between my records and yours.
例文翻译: 我的记录与您的记录之间似乎存在差异。

name: Duplicate
例文: Please do not send a duplicate copy of your application.
例文翻译: 请不要重复发送你的申请副本。

name: Ensure
例文: Please ensure that all the information provided is accurate.
例文翻译: 请确保所提供的所有信息都是准确的。

name: Essentially
例文: Essentially the study aims to improve brain-computer communication.
例文翻译: 本质上，这项研究旨在改善脑机通信。

name: Exceed
例文: The word count for the essay should not exceed 500 words.
例文翻译: 文章字数不应超过500字。

name: Exceptional
例文: The student showed exceptional talent in signal analysis.
例文翻译: 这个学生在信号分析方面表现出了非凡的天赋。

name: Exclusion
例文: The price of the tour is inclusive of meals but with the exclusion of drinks.
例文翻译: 行程价格包含餐费，但不含饮料。

name: Excursion
例文: The department is organizing a weekend excursion to a nearby city.
例文翻译: 系里正在组织一次去附近城市的周末远足。

name: Execution
例文: The success of the experiment depends on the careful execution of each step.
例文翻译: 实验的成功取决于每一步的仔细执行。

name: Exemption
例文: Students with high TOEFL scores may apply for an English class exemption.
例文翻译: 托福成绩高的学生可以申请免修英语课。

name: Exert
例文: The researchers exerted a lot of effort to obtain the neural data.
例文翻译: 研究人员付出了巨大努力以获得神经数据。

name: Exhaustive
例文: The report provides an exhaustive analysis of the research findings.
例文翻译: 该报告对研究结果提供了详尽的分析。

name: Expenditure
例文: The lab's expenditure on new sensors has increased this year.
例文翻译: 实验室今年在新型传感器上的支出增加了。

name: Expertise
例文: The project requires a high level of expertise in electronic engineering.
例文翻译: 该项目需要电子工程方面的高度专业知识。

name: Explanation
例文: Could you provide a more detailed explanation of this concept?
例文翻译: 您能对这个概念提供更详细的解释吗？

name: Exploration
例文: The course focuses on the exploration of new BCI technologies.
例文翻译: 这门课侧重于对新型脑机接口技术的探索。

name: Extend
例文: The library has decided to extend its opening hours during finals week.
例文翻译: 图书馆已决定在期末周延长开放时间。

name: External
例文: The university invited an external expert to evaluate the program.
例文翻译: 大学邀请了一位外部专家来评估该项目。

name: Facilitate
例文: The new online portal will facilitate communication between students and staff.
例文翻译: 新的在线门户将便利学生与教职员之间的沟通。

name: Faculty
例文: The faculty of engineering is known for its research excellence.
例文翻译: 工程学院以其卓越的研究而闻名。

name: Feasible
例文: The professor agreed that the proposed study was feasible.
例文翻译: 教授同意所提议的研究是可行的。

name: Financial
例文: The university offers financial aid to students in need.
例文翻译: 大学为有需要的学生提供经济援助。

name: Formal
例文: It is important to use a formal tone when emailing professors.
例文翻译: 给教授发邮件时使用正式语气很重要。

name: Format
例文: Please follow the required format for your research paper.
例文翻译: 请遵循研究论文要求的格式。

name: Function
例文: The main function of the software is to filter neural noise.
例文翻译: 该软件的主要功能是过滤神经噪声。

name: Fund
例文: The research was funded by a grant from the government.
例文翻译: 该研究由政府的一笔拨款资助。

name: Gap
例文: The study aims to fill the gap in current BCI research.
例文翻译: 该研究旨在填补目前脑机接口研究的空白。

name: Gateway
例文: The portal serves as a gateway to all university online services.
例文翻译: 该门户是通往大学所有在线服务的入口。

name: Gather
例文: We need to gather more data before we can reach a conclusion.
例文翻译: 在得出结论前，我们需要收集更多数据。

name: Gender
例文: The survey asks for basic demographic information including gender.
例文翻译: 调查要求提供基本的人口统计信息，包括性别。

name: General
例文: There is a general consensus that BCI technology will transform medicine.
例文翻译: 大家普遍认为脑机接口技术将改变医学。

name: Generate
例文: The solar panels generate enough energy to power the entire lab.
例文翻译: 太阳能电池板产生的能量足以供整个实验室使用。

name: Generic
例文: The email was sent with a generic greeting "Dear Student".
例文翻译: 邮件使用了通用的问候语，“亲爱的同学”。

name: Genuine
例文: The professor showed a genuine interest in my career plans.
例文翻译: 教授对我的职业规划表现出了真诚的兴趣。

name: Geography
例文: The students studied the geography of the region before the field trip.
例文翻译: 学生在实地考察前学习了该地区的地理。

name: Gesture
例文: Sending a thank-you note is a nice gesture after an interview.
例文翻译: 面试后寄一封感谢信是一种很好的表示。

name: Goal
例文: My ultimate goal is to apply BCI to elderly rehabilitation.
例文翻译: 我的终极目标是将脑机接口应用于老年人康复。

name: Grade
例文: I am satisfied with the grades I received this semester.
例文翻译: 我对这学期取得的成绩感到满意。

name: Graduate
例文: He is a graduate of a prestigious university in Japan.
例文翻译: 他是日本一所著名大学的毕业生。

name: Grant
例文: The professor granted my request for a late submission.
例文翻译: 教授同意了我迟交作业的请求。

name: Graphic
例文: The report includes several graphics to illustrate the data.
例文翻译: 报告包含几个图表来说明数据。

name: Grievance
例文: The student union helps students address their grievances with the university.
例文翻译: 学生会帮助学生处理对大学的不满。

name: Guarantee
例文: The company guarantees the security of all user data.
例文翻译: 公司保证所有用户数据的安全。

name: Guideline
例文: Please follow the safety guidelines while working in the lab.
例文翻译: 在实验室工作时请遵守安全准则。

name: Handout
例文: The professor distributed a handout with the key points of the lecture.
例文翻译: 教授分发了一份印有讲座要点的讲义。

name: Harassment
例文: The university has a zero-tolerance policy for any form of harassment.
例文翻译: 大学对任何形式的骚扰都持零容忍政策。

name: Hazardous
例文: Please handle the hazardous chemicals with extreme care.
例文翻译: 请极其小心地处理危险化学品。

name: Headquarters
例文: The company's headquarters are located in the center of Tokyo.
例文翻译: 公司总部位于东京市中心。
